svg.text: Laying out the activities and their order is its own
process (BP18). A simple project has no plan to open.
The archive is reached by an explicit act, and it holds the
activities and tasks that went down with a project.
Reading it, bringing one back and destroying one out of it
The parent may be an idea, a goal or a progress
measure, or there may be none. The kind holds for the
project's life, so it is declared once and is not amendable.
The activities and their tasks go with it. Nothing below a
Archiving a project is the only way an activity is archived
at all, and it is approved whole or rejected whole.
Everything the project is goes with it. Keeping anything
below it is not offered, because nothing below a project
The new template starts from four columns, one per role.
The kind is declared once and never migrates, and the
parent is single-valued. A plan orders and tracks; it
carries no duration, no float and no critical path.
An archived project is frozen until it is brought back, and
it comes back as the whole bundle it went as.
The parent survives a project's deletion. A goal left with
no linked idea is flagged on its current state.
